camel_example: aliyun cms PutMonitorGroupDynamicRule --region cn-hangzhou --GroupRules.1.Filters.1.Name hostName --GroupRules.1.Filters.1.Value nginx --GroupRules.1.Category ecs --GroupRules.1.Filters.1.Function contains --GroupRules.1.FilterRelation and --GroupId 123456
description_en: Creates or modifies an application group that dynamically matches instances by name. All instances that meet the matching rules are automatically added to the application group
description_zh: 调用PutMonitorGroupDynamicRule接口创建或修改按照实例名称动态匹配的应用分组，满足匹配规则的所有实例自动添加到该应用分组中
name: PutMonitorGroupDynamicRule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application group
parameters.name: group_id

fields.help_en:
The type of Alibaba Cloud service for the dynamic alert rule. Valid values of N: 1 to 3. Valid values:

ecs: Elastic Compute Service server.

rds: relational database.

slb: load balancing
fields.help_zh:
动态报警规则的云服务类型。N的取值范围：1~3。取值：

ecs：云服务器ECS。

rds：关系型数据库。

slb：负载均衡
fields.name: category

fields.help_en:
The combination condition for dynamic matching rules. Valid values of N: 1 to 3. Valid values:

and: Only instances that meet all matching rules are automatically added to the application group.

or: Instances that meet any matching rule are automatically added to the application group
fields.help_zh:
动态报警规则的组合条件。N的取值范围：1~3。取值：

and：满足所有报警规则的实例才会自动添加到应用分组。

or：满足任意报警规则的实例都会自动添加到应用分组
fields.name: filter_relation

fields.help_en:
The filter condition for instances. Valid values of N: 1 to 3. Valid values:
contains: Includes.
notContains: Does not include.
startWith: Prefix.
endWith: Suffix
fields.help_zh:
实例的过滤条件。N的取值范围：1~3。取值：
contains：包含。
notContains：不包含。
startWith：前缀。
endWith：后缀
fields.name: function

fields.help_en:
The field name for instance matching. Valid values of N: 1 to 3.

Currently, only the hostname is supported, such as hostName
fields.help_zh:
实例匹配的字段名称。N的取值范围：1~3。

目前仅支持主机名，例如：hostName
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The value that meets the matching condition. Valid values of N: 1 to 3
fields.help_zh: 满足报警条件的值。N的取值范围：1~3
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The mode for creating the dynamic matching rule. Valid values:

true: Asynchronous creation.
false (default): Synchronous creation
parameters.help_zh:
创建动态报警规则的模式。取值：

true：异步创建。
false（默认值）：同步创建
parameters.name: is_async

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to only precheck the request. Valid values:
true: sends a check request. No security group is associated with the instance. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and service limits are met. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check succeeds, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): sends a normal request. If the check succeeds, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会为实例绑定安全组。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see How to ensure idempotence
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见如何保证幂等性
parameters.name: client_token

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code.

A status code of 200 indicates success

Message.example: The specified resource is not found.

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values:

true: The operation was successful.

false: The operation failed
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
